title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Preparation and Dispatch of International Money Order Certificates or Lists)
(1) An exchange post office (meaning a post office that performs affairs concerning issuance and preparation of international money order certificates or lists and their exchange between countries; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall receive transmitted international money order remittance details from a remitting post office, prepare an international money order certificate or list, and dispatch it to the exchange post office of the country in which the relevant international money order is to be paid: Provided, That where the remitter is to send the international money order directly to the payee, the certificate shall be issued to the remitter.
(2) International money order certificates or lists shall be dispatched by registered airmail or telegraph.
